title: Add case_insensitive option to fields.Enum
description: Clients often send enum names or values in a different case ('MALE', 'Black Hair'). This adds case_insensitive=True to fields.Enum, which matches names (or string values with by_value) regardless of case. Non-string enum values are kept as-is in the lookup table. Tests cover both by-name and by-value.

bugs.description: val.lower() is called without checking the type. With by_value=True the inner field is Raw, so any non-string input (e.g. 12) raises AttributeError instead of a ValidationError (a 500 instead of a 400), and enums with int values crash even for valid input like 2. Unhashable input such as a list raises TypeError in the dict lookup. Fix: only lower() strings and catch (KeyError, TypeError).
